title: 2026-09-26 Public Data Center BOM / Architecture Re-validation

methodology.description: Re-run the current shared reference-blind v2 engine on 10 selected public architecture/BOM cases, then recompute metric-level absolute percentage error from reference and calculated values.
methodology.selection: Architecture-diverse subset spanning Google TPU, Meta RSC, ByteDance MegaScale, NVIDIA SuperPOD/NVL72, Frontier and Aurora.
methodology.important_limitation: These 10 cases are existing development/regression benchmark cases, not a new unseen hold-out set. The resulting precision is a reproducibility/regression statistic, not independent proof of cross-vendor generalization.
methodology.unsupported_fields: Undisclosed physical quantities such as exact cable length, patch-panel quantity, connector SKU or facility layout are excluded rather than guessed.

selected_cases.name: Google TPU v4
selected_cases.note: 4096-chip TPU v4 system; rack/block and OCS quantities are scored only where publicly disclosed.

selected_cases.name: Google TPU v6e / Trillium
selected_cases.note: 256-chip pod, 8 chips/host, 4×200G NIC/host, 25.6 Tbps pod DCN and published BF16 throughput.

selected_cases.name: Meta AI Research SuperCluster Phase 1
selected_cases.note: 760 DGX A100 / 6080 GPUs / storage and endpoint-bandwidth facts.

selected_cases.name: ByteDance MegaScale network building block
selected_cases.note: Network-port packing / ToR quantities from the public NSDI paper; not a full facility BOM.

selected_cases.name: NVIDIA DGX H100 SuperPOD
selected_cases.note: 4 SU / 128-node row; Leaf, Spine, node-leaf and leaf-spine counts.

selected_cases.name: NVIDIA DGX B200 SuperPOD
selected_cases.note: 16 SU / 512-node row; Leaf/Spine/Core and three cable-count layers.

selected_cases.name: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 rack
selected_cases.note: 18 compute trays, 72 GPUs, 36 Grace CPUs, 9 NVLink switch trays, 18 NVSwitches and 2 management ToRs.

selected_cases.name: Frontier
selected_cases.note: 9856 compute nodes from the User Guide is the frozen reference; the separate allocation page has a conflicting 9408-node figure.

selected_cases.name: Aurora
selected_cases.note: 10624 nodes, 166 racks, 63744 GPUs and network facts; published 2.12 PB/s injection value is rounded.

selected_cases.name: NVIDIA DGX B300 SuperPOD — 1 SU
selected_cases.source_type: Official NVIDIA reference architecture / user guide
selected_cases.note: Golden/reference case, not a strict hold-out: 72 systems, 576 GPUs, 8 Leaf, 4 Spine, 576 node-leaf and 576 leaf-spine.
